title: Consent
description: Record of one person allowing one agent one mandate, given on the box's consent page at the end of a standard OAuth authorization (code flow with PKCE). While it stands, the STS issues the agent grants under it; when it ends, by time or by revocation, it issues none.

mandate_version.description: Digest of the mandate as the user saw it. A changed mandate asks for consent again.

expires_at.description: No later than granted_at plus the mandate's consent.max_duration.

revoked_by.description: Who ended it: the user, an administrator, or the identity provider ending the user's session.

auth.description: How the user signed in to consent.

sid.description: The user's session at the identity provider.
